what: A background-color transition curtain split into rows the height of the header band (52px by default) — clicking a same-site link makes each row’s background color fill up from its bottom edge (scaleY 0→1, .5s power1.inOut, spreading from the bottom row up over .3s total), covers the screen, then navigates, and on the arriving page the whole covering curtain peels away from the bottom edge upward (clip-path inset(0 0 100% 0), 1.2s circ.inOut). While covering, a 20% dark ink shade settles over the screen behind for .8s

options.row: Row height in px or a selector for the element to measure (.site-header), default 52
options.rise: Duration of the line filling up (s), default .5
options.nav: With none it does not intercept links — a page transition library (barba etc.) calls it through el.fxCover() · el.fxReveal() (Promise) or the fx:cover · fx:reveal events. When covered it fires fx:covered, and when uncovered fx:done
options.[data-fx-part=shade]: (If any) Shade laid down while covering

from.where: shared.js page transition (barba 2.9.7) — original transitionMask(.l-transition__in scaleY .5s power1.inOut stagger amount .3 from end) + .l-transition clip-path 1.2s circ.inOut
